finding.title: Last page of order history still reports a next page
finding.explanation: `lastPage` is 1-based and inclusive, so `page <= lastPage` is still true on the last page. The account page renders a Next link there. Following it skips past every order and shows an empty list labelled "Page 4 of 3".
finding.reasoningSummary: page is 1-based (skip uses page - 1), and lastPage is ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE), the number of the last page. The comparison should be strict.
finding.suggestedFix: Use a strict comparison: hasNext: page < lastPage,

evidence.text:
return {
    orders: withItems,
    page,
    lastPage,
    hasNext: page <= lastPage,
    hasPrev: page > 1,
47 orders, PAGE_SIZE 20: lastPage = 3. On page 3, hasNext = (3 <= 3) = true. Page 4 skips 60 rows and returns none.
